cases.name: Nancy Jean Ludwig
cases.about: She was a flight attendant for Northwest Airlines.
cases.narrative:
Hotel staff discovered her face-down on her bed with multiple knife pricks, stab wounds, and she was nearly decapitated. He raped her, slit her throat and killed her and raped her again. 

He had turned on the television to CNN, taken a shower, wiped her body with a washcloth, untied her hands and packed everything in the blood-spattered room that might identify him, including the wastebasket trash bag. He removed her earrings and rings, picked up her identification and luggage, hung a "Do Not Disturb" sign on the door and disappeared into the night.
